name: six-face-full-run
description: The DEFAULT six-face run in policy mode, with zero timed inputs: hold fire, hold right while the world is scrolling, back off (the scroll is frozen, so retreating is free) while a wave gate's message is up and there is daylight to the damage plane, hop on every landing, and dodge a houndframe the moment it plants for its charge. Everything is position- or state-triggered because a 100+ second run's event times move with every tuning change — the case the README's policy mode exists for. WHERE IT STOPS, AND WHY — MEASURED WITH REPEATS, NOT FROM ONE RUN (T-009's playtest gate, 3 runs per side, both trees pinned, 150 s cap, --deterministic, 1440x900; evidence under tools/playtest/runs/gate-T-009-fullrun-{branch,branch-2,branch-3,main,main-2,main-3} and reports/tasks/T-009/playtest.md): task/T-009 reached maxX 89.25 / 89.25 / 110.65 (scroll 75 / 75 / 112) and a pristine snapshot of main reached 89.25 / 89.25 / 89.25 (scroll 75 x3). All six runs ended in GAME_OVER inside a wave gate fight; no run of this script on either tree has ever reached VICTORY. RETRACTED, DO NOT RE-QUOTE: the single-run-per-side A/B this description used to carry (branch maxX 154.3 / scroll 140 / 11 kills / 48.5 s vs main 89.3 / 75 / 8 / 27.1 s, three life losses at x 31.6 / 93.0 / 148.0, 'the lattice tree gets ~1.7x further') did not reproduce and was struck by the integrator as I-020. For scale on the harness noise: the same branch under ?zip=1 — a render-only flag whose simulation pathcheck proves identical — produced maxX 154.25 and 113.40, so the whole claimed lattice effect fits inside the spread of a flag that cannot touch the sim (playtest README 'Honesty / limitations' #2 and #8). What survives the repeats: both trees fail, main fails at the identical spot 3 times out of 3, and what stops the bot is the gate FIGHT — a reflex policy with no aim model against diving wasps in three lanes — not the geometry. The same policy driven through the sim with hostiles removed (tools/pathcheck.mjs, 'T-009: the run reaches the outro scroll end') crosses every face and every pocket chasm and reaches the outro with 2 lives. Use this script as the traversal+pressure smoke test it is. Proving boot-to-VICTORY is deliberately NOT this script's job and was split out of T-009 into its own task (T-018) by the integrator; do not retune waves or weaken pockets to move this number.
